input.title: KPC-2026-014: Rosemary Extract and Peptide Actives for Hair Growth Serum (Priority Lines)
input.scope: This RFx covers the priority actives for the hair growth serum: Rosemary leaf extract (RM-008), Copper Tripeptide-1 solution (RM-009), and Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 solution (RM-010). All five vendors on file are invited to quote for all three lines and to complete the questionnaire. Quotes should cover the full 6-month net volume with staged deliveries within the stated maximum per delivery, first need-by 20 December 2026 ahead of the 4 January 2027 production start.

line_notes.note: Rosemary leaf extract, 20% rosmarinic acid. Net 6M need 28 kg. Max per delivery 12 kg. Cool storage (below 25 C, to be confirmed). Minimum 12 months remaining shelf life on receipt. New vendor qualification required.

Copper Tripeptide-1 solution, 1,000 ppm peptide. Net 6M need 140 kg. Max per delivery 56 kg. Cold storage (2-8 C, to be confirmed). Minimum 9 months remaining shelf life on receipt. New vendor qualification required.

Acetyl Tetrapeptide-3 solution, 500 ppm peptide. Net 6M need 280 kg. Max per delivery 112 kg. Cold storage (2-8 C, to be confirmed). Minimum 9 months remaining shelf life on receipt. New vendor qualification required.

terms: On-time-in-full (OTIF) delivery performance is a scored criterion; late or short deliveries against the staged schedule are subject to defined remedies.
Defect and out-of-spec rate reported per batch; lots failing spec are rejected and replaced at vendor cost.
Cold chain (2-8 C, to be confirmed per product) maintained from dispatch to receipt for RM-009 and RM-010, with temperature logs supplied with each shipment.
Cool storage (below 25 C, to be confirmed) maintained for RM-008 with temperature records supplied.
Certificate of Analysis per batch stating peptide concentration (ppm), rosmarinic acid content (%), and microbial limits.
Shelf life stated at delivery; minimum remaining shelf life as per line notes.
All prices in INR, quoted per line with delivery schedule; inventory-holding or consignment options quoted to reduce working capital.
Vendor to confirm batch traceability back to raw material source and manufacturing site.
Vendors acting as traders must name the manufacturing site and provide the manufacturer's documents for each line.
questionnaire_focus: Manufacturing site and whether vendor is manufacturer or trader for each peptide and for rosemary extract
Source, extraction method and standardisation for rosemary extract; evidence of rosmarinic acid assay
Peptide synthesis route, purity method (HPLC), and stability data supporting 9-month shelf life at cold storage
Cold chain capability: packaging, shipping lanes, temperature monitoring and excursion handling
Historical OTIF and batch defect rates for comparable cosmetic actives
Ability to split 6-month volume into deliveries within stated maximum per delivery sizes
Regulatory documents: REACH/INCI conformity, GMP or ISO certification, and CoA sample
Lead time and minimum order quantities for first need-by 20 December 2026
Pricing breakdown in INR and any consignment or inventory-holding option
